legend: On the way to school, Karen became fixated on the puzzle game on her phone!
The game is played as follows. In each level, you have a grid with n rows and m columns. Each cell originally contains the number 0.
One move consists of choosing one row or column, and adding 1 to all of the cells in that row or column.
To win the level, after all the moves, the number in the cell at the i-th row and j-th column should be equal to gi, j.
Karen is stuck on one level, and wants to know a way to beat this level using the minimum number of moves. Please, help her with this task!
input: The first line of input contains two integers, n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100), the number of rows and the number of columns in the grid, respectively.
The next n lines each contain m integers. In particular, the j-th integer in the i-th of these rows contains gi, j (0 ≤ gi, j ≤ 500).
output: If there is an error and it is actually not possible to beat the level, output a single integer -1.
Otherwise, on the first line, output a single integer k, the minimum number of moves necessary to beat the level.
The next k lines should each contain one of the following, describing the moves in the order they must be done:
row x, (1 ≤ x ≤ n) describing a move of the form "choose the x-th row".
col x, (1 ≤ x ≤ m) describing a move of the form "choose the x-th column".
If there are multiple optimal solutions, output any one of them.

否则，在第一行输出一个整数 k，表示通过该关卡所需的最少操作次数。
接下来的 k 行中，每行都应包含以下内容之一，按必须执行的顺序描述这些操作：

如果有多个最优解，输出其中任意一个。

legend.ai: 在去学校的路上，Karen 对手机上的益智游戏着了迷！
游戏规则如下。在每个关卡中，你有一个 n 行 m 列的网格。每个单元格初始都包含数字 0。
一次操作包括选择一行或一列，并将该行或列中的所有单元格加 1。
为了通关，在所有操作完成后，第 i 行第 j 列单元格中的数字应等于 g_{i,j}。
Karen 被困在一个关卡中，想知道一种使用最少操作次数通过该关卡的方法。请帮助她完成这项任务！

input.ai: 输入第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n，m ≤ 100），分别表示网格的行数和列数。
接下来的 n 行每行包含 m 个整数。具体地，这些行中第 i 行的第 j 个整数表示 g_{i,j}（0 ≤ g_{i,j} ≤ 500）。
